forwardToPhoneNumber.description: Phone number to forward calls to during this schedule.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Enables forwarding for all calls to voicemail. This option is only available for internal phone numbers or extensions.

scheduleName.description: Name of the location's schedule which determines when the selective forward is in effect.

callsFrom.description: Indicates whether to apply the selective forward criteria for calls from Any Phone Number, Select Phone Numbers or Forwarded ones.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, enables selective forward to calls from anonymous callers.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, enables selective forward to calls if the callers are unavailable.

numbers.description: List of phone numbers checked against incoming calls for a match.

forwardEnabled.description: Indicates whether the calls, that fit within these parameters, will be forwarded (if forwardEnabled = `true`) or not (if forwardEnabled = `false`).
